why: This is a study-developed measurement instrument rather than a reusable instructional element or teaching design.
name: 44-item ethical GenAI use questionnaire
product_description: A self-administered five-point Likert questionnaire developed by Tabares-Cruz et al. to measure university students' ethical, cognitive, self-regulatory, and institutional dimensions of generative-AI use across seven dimensions.

why: This is a study-specific assessment instrument for measuring dental students' TDI knowledge and confidence, not a general instructional element.
name: 44-item IADT-based TDI knowledge and confidence questionnaire
product_description: A researcher-developed questionnaire assessing fourth-year dental students' knowledge and self-reported confidence in managing traumatic dental injuries across primary and permanent dentitions.
